common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.tagline: The weekly menu and the shopping list, for people who eat together: family, flatmates, friends, a sports team or an office.
auth.signInWithEmail: Sign in with email and password
auth.invitationOnly: Access is by invitation: once signed in, you can join the team that invited you.
auth.invitedSignIn: You have been invited to a team. Sign in or create an account to accept.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.body: You have been invited to join the “{{team}}” team.

state.accepted: This invitation has already been used.
state.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.

error.notFound: Invitation not found. Check the link.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

meal.menuEmpty: No dishes. Pick them from the recipe book, or generate the week's menu from the button on the Menu screen.
meal.addDish: Add a dish from the recipe book
meal.memberNotice: Only the team's owners can change people and dishes.
meal.breakfastHint: Breakfast is only counted: the menu plans lunch and dinner.

calendar.title: Weekly menu
calendar.hint: Tap a meal to see people and dishes. People at the table come from the team's typical week.
calendar.dialogHint: Change the people for this date only: other days follow the typical week.
calendar.dialogHintDayOff: This day is usually not planned: set the people to open it on this date only.
calendar.noteHint: Optional, e.g. "guests for dinner", "out for lunch"
calendar.hintOwner: Tap a meal to manage people and dishes; the gear (or the date) sets up the day, the bin clears it. Other days follow the team's typical week.

book.title: Recipe book
book.emptyHint: Add the recipes you usually cook with the + button: tell them to the assistant or write them yourself.

recipe.removePrivate: This recipe is private: removing it from the recipe book deletes it.
recipe.removeShared: The recipe stays available to other teams, but will no longer be in your recipe book.

editor.title: Title
editor.cuisineHint: E.g. Italian, Japanese; type a new one if missing
editor.servingsHint: Quantities are for this many people
editor.seasonAutoHint: Computed from the ingredients: {{season}}. Change it to decide yourself.
editor.seasonUserHint: Set by you: no longer recomputed from the ingredients.
editor.climateHint: When the dish suits the weather (a hot soup is not for August).
editor.fromAssistant: Draft prepared by the assistant: check ingredients, amounts and seasonality before saving.
editor.unresolved: Some proposed ingredients are not in the catalog yet: create them or pick an existing one.
editor.unresolvedCount_one: One ingredient is not in the catalog: create it or pick an existing one.
editor.unresolvedCount_other: {{count}} ingredients are not in the catalog: create them or pick existing ones.
editor.saveFailed: Could not save: see the message at the top.

ingredient.sharedHint: A system ingredient: every team uses it. Use a simple, singular name.
ingredient.name: Name
ingredient.nameHint: E.g. tomato, not “ripe tomatoes” (details go in the note); preserved forms are separate: “peeled tomato”
ingredient.suggested: Category, unit and season are suggested by the assistant: check them.
ingredient.editHint_one: Used by {{count}} recipe: changes apply to every team, and recipe seasons will be recomputed.
ingredient.editHint_other: Used by {{count}} recipes: changes apply to every team, and recipe seasons will be recomputed.
ingredient.aliasesHint: Other ways it is written (plural, variants): press Enter after each
ingredient.exists: An ingredient with this name or alias already exists.
ingredient.teamHint: You add it to your team's ingredients: only your team sees it, until staff make it available to everyone. Use a simple, singular name.
ingredient.addedBy: Added by “{{team}}”: only that team sees and uses it.

intro.tell: Tell me the recipe the way you would tell a friend: ingredients, amounts if you know them, how you make it. I will prepare a draft for you to check.
intro.search: Tell me what you feel like: an ingredient, an occasion, a constraint (“a quick pumpkin pasta, for kids”). I search your recipe book, the other teams' recipes and the web. You can then refine.
intro.link: Paste the link of the page with the recipe: I will read it and prepare a draft for you to check. Pasting a link in “Tell me the recipe” works too.
intro.photo: Send me a photo of the recipe: a cookbook page, a handwritten card, a screenshot. If it spans several pages, send the photos one after the other. I will read the text and prepare a draft for you to check.

placeholder.tell: E.g. “My grandmother's pasta e ceci, for 4…”
placeholder.photo: Type something if you like, then tap the camera

assistant.draftReady: Here is the draft: check it below, or tell me what to change.
assistant.unavailable: The assistant is not answering. Is Unsloth Studio running?

importError.generic: I could not import a recipe from this link.
importError.invalid_url: The link does not look valid: it must start with http:// or https://.
importError.unreachable: I cannot reach the page. Check the link or try again later.
importError.forbidden_address: This address is not a public web page, so I cannot open it.
importError.http_error: The site refused the request (some sites block automated access). Try pasting the recipe text instead.
importError.not_html: The link does not lead to a web page (maybe a PDF or an image).
importError.too_large: The page is too large to read.
importError.too_many_redirects: The link redirects too many times.
importError.no_content: The page has no readable text: it may be built by JavaScript, or be a video or social post. Try pasting the recipe text instead.
importError.no_recipe: I found no recipe on the page. Try pasting the recipe text instead.
importError.no_text_in_photo: I cannot read any text in the photo. Try a sharper, closer photo in good light.

assistant.photoUnreadable: I cannot open this image. Try a JPEG or PNG photo.

search.nothing: I found nothing. Try other words or the name of a dish.

notice.web_search_unavailable: Web search is not available with the configured model.
notice.web_search_empty: I found no single-recipe pages on the web. Try naming a specific dish.
notice.web_search_failed: The web search did not answer. Try again shortly.

tool.name: Name
tool.sharedHint: Kitchen tools are common to all teams: use a simple name.
tool.heatsKitchenHint: Like an oven or a deep fryer: summer menus will take it into account.
tool.exists: A kitchen tool with this name already exists.

ingredients.mergeHint_one: Recipes using “{{name}}” ({{count}}) will use the chosen ingredient, and “{{name}}” becomes one of its aliases. Useful for duplicates.
ingredients.mergeHint_other: Recipes using “{{name}}” ({{count}}) will use the chosen ingredient, and “{{name}}” becomes one of its aliases. Useful for duplicates.
ingredients.deleteHint: The ingredient will be removed from the shared catalog.
ingredients.inUse: It cannot be deleted: these recipes use it. You can merge it into another ingredient.
ingredients.teamsHint: Ingredients teams added for themselves. Make them system ingredients, so every team can use them, or merge them into an existing one. Those used in shared recipes, which other teams already see, come first.
ingredients.promoteClash: A system ingredient “{{name}}” already exists: merge this one into it.

rules.hint: They apply to every team's menus, and teams see them read-only. Changes take effect at once, with no release. Rules shipped with the app are switched off, not deleted.

noTeam.title: Just the invitation missing
noTeam.body: You are signed in as {{email}}, but your account is not part of any team yet.
noTeam.hint: Ask whoever manages your team to send you an invitation link, then open it in this browser.

team.memberNotice: Only the team's owners can change these settings.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Team name
profile.maxMinutesHint: Preparation + cooking you can manage on an ordinary day
profile.toolsHint: Recipes needing other tools will not be suggested
profile.signRecipes: Sign shared recipes with the team's name
profile.signedHint: In the community your shared recipes show as "by {{name}}".
profile.anonymousHint: In the community your shared recipes show without a name, as "Community".

people.title: People at the table
people.hint: Who usually eats with you, even without an account (e.g. children). Ages help compare similar teams.
people.name: Name

users.title: Users and roles
users.hint: Who uses the app for this team. Owners manage the team; members use the recipe book and menus.
users.leaveHint: You will no longer see this team's recipe book and menus. Coming back takes a new invitation.
users.removeHint: They will lose access to the team. Coming back takes a new invitation.
users.lastOwner: A team needs at least one owner: make someone else owner first.

invites.title: Invitations
invites.hint: Create a link and send it to whoever should join: it works once, for 14 days.
invites.memberHint: Invitations are created by the team's owners.

week.title: Typical week
week.memberNotice: Only the team's owners can change the typical week and the rules.

pattern.title: Meals and people
pattern.hint: How many people usually eat at each meal. The calendar and the menus start from here; a day switched off is not planned.

rules.title: Team rules
rules.hint: Guidance in plain language for planning the menus, one per line. They apply every week; when you plan a week you can leave some out or add others.
rules.placeholder: E.g. "fish at least twice", "pizza on Friday evening", "quick dishes at lunch"

system.title: System rules
system.hint: They apply to every team. The team's rules and the week's take precedence.

plan.title: How should I plan the menu?
plan.placeholder: E.g. "Thursday dinner we are five", "no fish", "quick lunch on Wednesday"
plan.instructionsHint: Applies to this week only and takes precedence over the rules. You can also change the people at the table: the changes will be proposed for you to confirm.
plan.noTeamRules: The team has no rules yet.
plan.precedence: When two instructions conflict, the week's wins, then the team's. The dishes you have already chosen stay.

menuFab.label: Plan the menu
menuFab.plan: Tell me how to plan it

generation.runningHint: It may take a few minutes. You can leave the page: the proposal will wait for you here.
generation.failed: The menu could not be planned
generation.unplanned_one: {{count}} meal was not planned: complete it by hand or generate again.
generation.unplanned_other: {{count}} meals were not planned: complete them by hand or generate again.
generation.reviewHint: Proposed dishes are marked with ✦. Accept or reject them meal by meal from the cards, or all at once.
generation.replaceConfirm: Proposals not accepted yet will be replaced. The dishes you chose stay. Continue?
generation.mealProposal: The generator proposes this meal: accept it to keep it, or reject it.

phase.preparing: Gathering the week's rules, recipes and people…
phase.thinking: The model is reasoning about the week…
phase.planning: The model is placing the rules on the meals…
phase.writing: The model is writing the meals: {{done}} of {{total}}
phase.retrying: The answer was not usable: trying again…

settings.hint: Application settings, for every team. They take effect at once, with no restart; only administrators see them.

llm_context_tokens.label: Model context (tokens)
llm_context_tokens.hint: The context size the model is loaded with in Unsloth Studio. It sets how much text prompts may carry (the assistant's conversations, candidate recipes for the menu). Never more than the loaded model really has.

menu_thinking.label: Model reasoning
menu_thinking.hint: The model reasons before proposing the week: it follows the rules better, but takes about four times as long (2-3 minutes instead of 30-40 seconds). Needs a context of at least 32,768 tokens.

menu_max_seconds.label: Longest a generation may take (seconds)
menu_max_seconds.hint: Past this time, attempts included, the generation is stopped and marked failed. With reasoning on, a week takes 2-3 minutes.

ui_compact_actions.label: Compact actions
ui_compact_actions.hint: On a recipe's page, the actions (edit, remove, add) become icons only, aligned right beside the tabs or the title. Applies to every user.

cache.hint: Rules and settings go through a two-level cache: each backend process's memory first, then Redis, shared by all. Every change to rules or settings empties it by itself; the button is for data changed some other way (for example from the Django admin).
cache.clearConfirm: Clear the cache? The data will be read from the database again on the next read.
cache.redisDown: Redis cannot be reached: the app keeps working from the database, a little slower.
cache.sharedHint: Common to every process. A value stays at most {{ttl}}.
cache.processHint: Counters of the process that answered (each has its own). A value stays at most {{ttl}}: changes made elsewhere arrive within that time.

community.empty: No recipes in the community yet.
community.importing: You are creating your version of "{{title}}": it goes in your recipe book in place of the original, which does not change and stays in the community.
community.variantsHint: Versions of this recipe changed and shared by other teams.
community.variantsOfOriginalHint: The other versions of the same original recipe.
community.chooseSharing: Choose whether to share the recipe with the community.
community.sharingQuestion: Share this recipe with the community?
community.shareOption: Yes, share it with the community
community.privateOption: No, keep it for the team
community.sharingHint: Every new recipe asks: there is no default.
community.sharedHint: Every team will see it, and can use it as it is or import it to change it. The team's name shows only if the team chose to sign its recipes (team profile).
community.systemHint: System recipes are always in the community and only staff change them.
community.originalHint: The original recipe, as it is now. Quantities are for the same people, to compare them.
community.differencesHint: Differences from the original are marked on the ingredients.
community.noDifferences: Ingredients and steps are the same as the original.
community.notChangedYet: You have not changed it yet: it is the same as the original. Changing it creates your version, and the original does not change.
community.removeChanged: You changed this recipe: removing it from the book loses your version and its changes. The original stays in the community.
community.removeReference: The recipe stays in the community: you can add it again whenever you like.

drafts.hint: System recipes (PlateMates) written by the model from real recipe pages found on the web. Every draft is reviewed and published by you: nothing becomes a recipe by itself.
drafts.dishesPlaceholder:
Ribollita
Pasta alla Norma
Vitello tonnato
drafts.themePlaceholder: E.g. "autumn first courses", "quick fish main courses"
drafts.themeHint: The model suggests the dishes, leaving out existing system recipes.
drafts.modelDown: The model is not answering right now.

phase.drafting_zero: no source: the model writes it…

drafts.noSources: No source found: written by the model without checks, review it carefully.
drafts.webRatingHint: The average rating the recipe has on the pages it was drafted from, weighted by number of votes.
drafts.editRetryHint: Change or narrow the dish (e.g. "pasta e fagioli alla veneta"), then try again: the previous result is replaced.

transfer.hint: Move data between PlateMates installations (from the Mac to the server, say) as a JSON file. Users do not travel: an imported team belongs to whoever imports it, or goes into a team that already exists.

scopeHint.team: People, preferences, rules, calendar, the recipe book with its ratings, the team's own recipes (versions included) and ingredients, the menus. System or community recipes in the book are only referred to: export the system data too.
scopeHint.recipes: The chosen recipes, with their ingredients, kitchen tools and cuisine.
scopeHint.system: System ingredients, kitchen tools, cuisines, system rules and PlateMates' recipes.

transfer.importHint: Preview first: it says what would be created, updated or skipped, changing nothing. Importing the same file again creates no duplicates.
transfer.targetAuto: Automatic: the same team, or a new one
transfer.targetHint: To bring the team into one that already exists here (e.g. created for the same people).

modeHint.skip: What already exists stays as it is; only what is missing is added.
modeHint.update: What already exists takes the file's values (even if it was changed here since).

transfer.previewOf: Preview of the “{{scope}}” file exported on {{date}}: nothing has changed yet.
transfer.teamNew: Team “{{name}}” will be created, with you as owner.
transfer.empty: The file has nothing to import.

usage.hint: What the models (Claude, OpenAI) consumed, by team, feature and model. Costs are estimates from the price list below: the provider's invoice is what counts.
usage.unpriced_one: {{count}} call to a model without a price (local): not counted.
usage.unpriced_other: {{count}} calls to models without a price (local): not counted.
usage.pricesHint: Prices in US dollars, per million tokens and per thousand web searches, as the providers publish them. Correcting one recalculates past months too.
